about: Model verdicts on source against tree for adl (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The box has one column, but each regulation's single cell is split into two cells in mid-sentence, giving an invented second column; all words are kept.
findings.evidence: source: "as evidence that the requirements of regulation 26 have been satisfied" / tree: "...the requirements of" | "regulation 26 have been satisfied..."

findings.problem: The box has one column, but the single cell for regulation 27C is split into two cells in mid-sentence, giving an invented second column; all words are kept.
findings.evidence: source: "A local authority is authorised to accept, as evidence" / tree: "...is authorised to" | "accept, as evidence that..."

findings.problem: In the hot water cylinder row the exponent two-thirds on V is flattened, so the formula reads as V2/3 instead of V to the power 2/3.
findings.evidence: source: "0.85 × (0.2 + 0.051 V^(2/3)) kWh/day" (2/3 printed as a superscript) / tree: "0.85 × (0.2 + 0.051 V2/3) kWh/day"

findings.problem: The column headings of Table 4.3 have words that are not printed, and the two value columns (a) Threshold and (b) Improved are joined into one cell per row; the values themselves are right.
findings.evidence: source: "Element" "U-value(1) W/(m2·K)" "(a) Threshold" "(b) Improved" / tree: "Element type" "Maximum U-value(1) W/(m2·K)" "(a) Threshold 0.35; (b) Improved 0.16"

findings.problem: In the note to Table 4.5 the multiplication sign of the formula is a broken character and the exponent 0.4 is flattened, so the formula cannot be read correctly.
Paragraphs 5.5, 5.6 and 5.7 are ordinary numbered guidance after the worked example ends, but the heading path puts them inside the worked example under Primary energy.
findings.evidence: source: "5.5 Where a replacement fixed building service involves a fuel-switch" / tree: "Replacement building services in existing dwellings > Worked example > Primary energy > Paragraph 5.5"

findings.problem: The printed table has three columns, but the grid has only two: the Notes column is folded into the Minimum efficiency cells behind a "Notes:" marker.
findings.evidence: source: "System type | Minimum efficiency | Notes" / tree: columns "System type", "Minimum efficiency"; cell "92% (as defined in ErP(1)). Notes: Or, in exceptional circumstances"

findings.problem: The printed table has three columns, but the grid has only two: the Notes column is folded into the Minimum efficiency cells behind a "Notes:" marker.
findings.evidence: source: "System type | Minimum efficiency | Notes" / tree: columns "System type", "Minimum efficiency"; cell "80%. Notes: Follow paragraph 6.9"

findings.problem: The closing sentences of paragraph 7.2, printed as a separate paragraph after the list, are joined onto list item b.
findings.evidence: source: "b. A period in accordance with manufacturer’s guidance." then new paragraph "Calibration should be carried out in accordance with CIBSE’s TM23." / tree: both in item b

findings.problem: The second introductory paragraph of the Intention, about work on an existing dwelling, is joined onto list item b of the first list.
findings.evidence: source: "b. Other important documentation, as given in paragraphs 9.3 to 9.5." then new paragraph "In the Secretary of State’s view, the requirements of regulations 40 and 40A" / tree: both in item b

findings.problem: The one-column regulation box is given as one row with two cells, cut in the middle of sub-paragraph (f), so the second cell sits under no column.
findings.evidence: source: "(f) in the case of a material change of use described in regulation 5(a)" / tree: "(f) in the case of a material" | "change of use described in regulation 5(a)"

findings.problem: The first row of the one-column regulation box is split into two cells in the middle of paragraph (3), so the second cell sits under no column.
findings.evidence: source: "materials of European Classification A2-s1, d0 or A1" / tree: "materials of European Classification" | "A2-s1, d0 or A1, classified in accordance with"

findings.problem: The unit of the dwelling primary energy rate lost its PE subscript, so it reads as plain kWh instead of kWh of primary energy.
findings.evidence: source: "Expressed as kWhPE/(m2·year)" / tree: "Expressed as kWh / (m2·year)"

findings.problem: The asterisk that marks two terms as coming from the Building Regulations 2010 is dropped from their titles, though the note above still refers to items marked *.
findings.evidence: source: "*Controlled service or fitting", "*Energy efficiency requirements" / tree: "Controlled service or fitting", "Energy efficiency requirements"

findings.problem: The note marker (1) on the second column heading is dropped from the grid's column name, so note 1 is no longer tied to that column.
findings.evidence: source: "Reference value for target setting(1)" / tree: "Reference value for target setting"

findings.problem: The exponent 2/3 on V in the hot water cylinder loss factor is flattened, so it reads as V times 2/3 or V2 over 3 instead of V to the power 2/3.
findings.evidence: source: "0.85 × (0.2 + 0.051 V^(2/3)) kWh/day" (2/3 printed as superscript) / tree: "0.85 × (0.2 + 0.051 V2/3) kWh/day"

findings.problem: The LENI formula is scrambled: the fraction and the subscripts are run into the sentence, though the sentence before it still states the rule in words.
findings.evidence: source: "LENI (%) = (Ep + Ed + En) / A" / tree: "E + E + E LENI (%) = p d n A"

findings.problem: The boxed running text of regulations 27 and 27C is held as a one-column table, and each regulation is split into two cells in the middle of paragraph (4).
findings.evidence: source: "as evidence that the requirements of regulation 26 have been satisfied" / tree: cell 1 ends "that the requirements of", cell 2 starts "regulation 26 have been satisfied"

findings.problem: The second column name drops the words "or air permeability", although the last row gives an air permeability value and not a U-value.
findings.evidence: source: "Maximum U-value(1) W/(m2·K) or air permeability" / tree: "Maximum U-value(1) W/(m2·K)"

findings.problem: The two value columns (a) Threshold and (b) Improved are merged into one cell per row instead of being two columns; the values are still labelled correctly.
findings.evidence: source: "(a) Threshold" 0.35 | "(b) Improved" 0.16 / tree: "(a) Threshold 0.35; (b) Improved 0.16"

findings.problem: The column names are changed and the word "Maximum" is added, which is not printed in this table's heading.
findings.evidence: source: "Element", "U-value(1) W/(m2·K)" / tree: "Element type", "Maximum U-value(1) W/(m2·K)"

findings.problem: The second column name in Table 4.3 has the words 'for reference space' added; the printed heading is only 'Average zone height'.
findings.evidence: source: "Average zone height" / tree: "Average zone height for reference space"

findings.problem: The joined column names in Table 4.4 drop the words 'for low temperature hot water systems' and the note markers (1)(2)(3) from the spanning heading.
findings.evidence: source: "Minimum insulation thickness (mm) for low temperature hot water systems(1)(2)(3)" / tree: "Minimum insulation thickness (mm), thermal conductivity (λ) = 0.025W/m·K"

findings.problem: The joined column names in Table 4.5 drop the words 'for domestic hot water services' and the note markers (1)(2)(3) from the spanning heading.
findings.evidence: source: "Minimum insulation thickness (mm) for domestic hot water services(1)(2)(3)" / tree: "Minimum insulation thickness (mm), thermal conductivity (λ) = 0.04W/m·K"

findings.problem: The exponent 2/3 in the two formulas of note 2 is flattened to normal text, so the power of V reads as a multiplier or fraction.
The second lead-in sentence, for existing buildings, is joined onto list item c of the new building list instead of standing as its own line before the second list.
findings.evidence: tree: "c. Any on-site electricity generation is both appropriately sized and has controls. In the Secretary of State’s view, requirements L1(b)(i), (ii) and L2 are met in existing buildings"

findings.problem: Table 6.3 has the column headings of Table 6.2, so the net efficiency is labelled as gross boiler efficiency and the real headings are lost.
findings.evidence: source: "Warm air heater type | Heat generator seasonal efficiency (net calorific value/thermal efficiency) | Product standard" / tree: "Fuel type | System | Boiler seasonal efficiency (gross calorific value)"

findings.problem: The efficiency and product standard columns are merged into one cell and an empty 'System' column is invented.
findings.evidence: source: "91%" | "BS EN 13842" / tree: "" | "91% (net calorific value/thermal efficiency); product standard: BS EN 13842"

findings.problem: In paragraph 6.12 the sentence that starts the second list is joined onto item b of the first list.
findings.evidence: source: "b. BS EN 13842." then new line "The calculation of the thermal efficiency (net calorific value) should both:" / tree: "b. BS EN 13842. The calculation of the thermal efficiency (net calorific value) should both:"

findings.problem: Equation 6.6 in paragraph 6.25 is scrambled, so the formula for heater output cannot be read.
findings.evidence: source: "heater output = recovery rate of heater in litres/second × specific heat capacity of water × temperature rise of water" / tree: "recovery rate specific heat heater temperature rise = of heater in × capacity of × equation 6.6 output of water litres/second water"

findings.problem: In paragraph 6.30 the closing sentence, which applies to the whole paragraph, is joined onto item b.
findings.evidence: source: "b. The system temperature gets too high." then new line "Manual reset should be possible if there is an over-temperature trip." / tree: "b. The system temperature gets too high. Manual reset should be possible if there is an over-temperature trip."

findings.problem: Table 6.6 splits the heading 'Cooling unit SEER' in two, so the unnamed sub-type column is called 'Cooling unit'; the values are still right.
findings.evidence: source: "Type | (no heading) | Cooling unit SEER" / tree: "Type | Cooling unit | SEER"

findings.problem: The formula in note 4 is broken: the multiplication signs became bad characters, the subscripts sit on separate lines and the fraction line (division) is lost.
findings.evidence: source: "[(Pmains,1 × SFP1) + (Pmains,2 × SFP2) + (Pmains,3 × SFP3) + ...] / (Pmains,1 + Pmains,2 + Pmains,3 +...)" / tree: "[(P �SFP ) + (P � SFP )+(P � SFP )+ ...] mains,1 1 mains,2 2 mains,3 3 (P + P + P +...)"

findings.problem: The exponent 0.65 in the air leakage limit is flattened onto the line in all four rows, so the power is no longer shown as a power.
findings.evidence: source: "0.027 ∆p^0.65" (0.65 printed as superscript) / tree: "0.027 ∆p0.65"

findings.problem: The superscript 2 in the unit of the last column heading is flattened.
findings.evidence: source: "l/(s·m²) of duct surface area" / tree: "l/(s·m2) of duct surface area)(1)"

findings.problem: The area-weighted U-value expression is printed as a fraction, but the tree runs numerator and denominator together with no division sign.
The NOTE printed under Table 10.1 is placed at the end of paragraph 10.9, before the table.
findings.evidence: source: Table 10.1, then "NOTE: Vehicle access doors, display windows and similar glazing and smoke vents can be as large an area" / tree: the NOTE comes before the table

findings.problem: The regulation box has one column but its single row holds two cells, with the text cut in the middle of item (f).
findings.evidence: tree: cell 1 ends "(f) in the case of a material" / cell 2 starts "change of use described in regulation 5(a), (b), (c), (g), (h) or (i), E1 to E3"

findings.problem: The first grid row is split into two cells in the middle of paragraph (3), though the box has one column and the sentence is continuous.
findings.evidence: source: "materials of European Classification A2-s1, d0 or A1, classified in accordance with" / tree: "...materials of European Classification" | "A2-s1, d0 or A1, classified..."

findings.problem: The row label in the last row of Table A1 is wrong in the grid.
The definition of fixed building services, whose item c is on this page, is merged into the Fit-out work definition instead of being its own definition.
findings.evidence: tree (under Fit-out work): "after the shell has been completed. *Fixed building services Defined in regulation 2(1) as any part of" ... "c. any combination of systems of the kinds referred to in paragraph (a) or (b)."

findings.problem: The second half of the defined term is left out of the title and starts the definition text.
findings.evidence: source: "Heating appliance or heat generator The part of a heating system" / tree: title "Heating appliance", text "or heat generator The part of a heating system"

findings.problem: The definition of Material change of use, with its list a to k, is merged into the Major renovation definition instead of being its own definition.
findings.evidence: source: "*Material change of use Defined in regulation 5 as:" / tree (under Major renovation): "building envelope undergoes renovation. *Material change of use Defined in regulation 5 as:"

findings.problem: The multiplication sign in the luminaire lumens formula is replaced by a broken character.
findings.evidence: source: "(light source lumens × light output ratio)" / tree: "(light source lumens � light output ratio)"

findings.problem: The three paragraphs printed after list item b are joined onto item b as if they were part of it.
findings.evidence: source: "b. is started within the period of six months beginning on that day." then new paragraph "Please note that" / tree: "b. is started within the period of six months beginning on that day. Please note that"

findings.problem: The amendment instruction for paragraph 6.20 is attached to the end of paragraph 2.10 instead of standing on its own before paragraph 6.20.
findings.evidence: source: "Page 44 Replace paragraph 6.20 and note with the following." / tree (in 2.10): "Section 6 of this approved document. Page 44 Replace paragraph 6.20 and note with the following."

findings.problem: The first line of the title block is not in the chapter title.
findings.evidence: source: "The Building Regulations 2010"
